data.title: Special Forces for Road Security in Aseer Region Apprehend Environmental Law Violator
data.content:
Abha, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Special Forces for Road Security in Aseer Region apprehended a Pakistani resident for violating the Environmental Law after he was found in possession of locally sourced firewood offered for sale. The seized firewood was handed over to the relevant authorities.
    This comes as part of the Ministry of Interior's efforts to monitor the marketing of locally sourced charcoal and firewood within cities and governorates, along roads connecting regions, and through unauthorized advertisements on various platforms.
    The Public Security urged the public to report any violations involving the environment or wildlife by calling 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh, and Eastern regions, or 996 and 999 in the rest of the Kingdom.
    -- SPA
